measurement_independence_note: songbpm.com, songdata.io, tunebat.com, musicgateway.com and getsongbpm.com all republish Spotify audio-analysis estimates (or closely related analysers). Concordance between two of them therefore confirms transcription, not independent measurement. No recording in this dataset has an independently measured key or BPM.
